evidence.field: 漢字甲骨部件分析 / 网; form, structure, and oracle-bone usage
evidence.text: The account says oracle-bone and bronze forms depict a spread net with crossing mesh lines; 网 is the early graph for 網. It reports oracle-bone verb uses for catching game, including 合集 10514 「网雉，隻（獲）八」 and 合集 28329 「网鹿」, and says bronze forms also served in names. It describes later graphic development by joining the net’s upper lines into a horizontal stroke, then adding 亡 to form 罔 and 糸 to form 網. These are the source’s analyses; the cited page does not supply absolute dates for the listed inscriptions.
evidence.title: 漢字甲骨部件分析: 网

evidence.field: 網 / formation analysis and Guangyun entry
evidence.text: The database analyzes 網 as 糸 semantic plus 罔 phonetic, and gives the historical sequence as net graph 网, graph 罔 with 亡 added as a sound element, then 網 with 糸 added semantically. It records 網’s Guangyun 文兩切 and Middle Chinese category 微母, 上聲, 陽/養 rhyme, 合口三等. This is database analysis and rhyme-book metadata, not an independently dated account of each graphic step.
evidence.kind: character-specific formation analysis and historical reading record
evidence.title: 網 — 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.source: 教育部《異體字字典》 (Taiwan Ministry of Education)
evidence.field: A03137 / 說文釋形, 字樣說明, senses
evidence.text: The entry says the Shuowen regular seal form is 网; it records the transmitted note that canonical texts changed the clerical form to 䍏, and that 网 may appear with 亡 or 糸. It describes later regular 網 as 糸 plus 罔 and explicitly says 糸罔聲. It lists physical net as the first sense, verb ‘catch with a net’, net-like things, network systems, and figurative restraint, citing texts including 詩經《新臺》 for fish nets and 《史記》 for the figurative ‘web’ of governance. Its cited examples document senses but do not establish first occurrences or a complete semantic chronology.
evidence.kind: official lexicographic account and cited historical examples
evidence.title: [A03137] 網 — 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: 教育部《異體字字典》 (Taiwan Ministry of Education)
evidence.field: A03137-003 / relation of 网 and 網
evidence.text: The entry classifies 网 as an alternate form of 網, quoting 玉篇 and 廣韻, and notes historical usage of both shapes. Its account supports a lexical/graphic variant relationship; it does not call simplified 网 an entirely newly created graphic. This sits alongside CUHK’s account that modern simplified writing revived the early graph.
evidence.kind: official lexicographic account of graphic relation
evidence.title: [A03137-003] 网 (網) — 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: File description / source, image link, license
evidence.text: The exact file page identifies the vector as a modern digital depiction of 网 in Shuowen seal-script style and points to an original SVG. It attributes the underlying form to the Sinica database and states that Sinica-derived picture is CC0 1.0; the file page itself also presents a CC0 release. This is a modern redraw of a script form, not an ancient artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:网-seal.svg — Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The opened character page shows modern Mandarin wang with tone rendered as an image, and displays Guangyun 文兩切 plus the Middle Chinese category. Exact current kMandarin rows were checked in local sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt: 網 wǎng, 网 wǎng, 罔 wǎng. Exact local Baxter–Sagart 2014 rows in sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv give 網 and 网 MC mjangX, OC *maŋʔ (or *C.maŋʔ ?), and 罔 with the same notation. These local rows are dataset cross-checks, not external evidence or proof of phonetic function. Unicode’s prescribed individual lookup URLs for U+7DB2, U+7F51, and U+7F54 were attempted but inaccessible in this session.
evidence.kind: external reading evidence with explicitly attributed local dataset cross-check
evidence.title: 網 — 漢語多功能字庫

search_audit.query: Direct Unicode Unihan individual records by code point 7F51, 7DB2, and 7F54
search_audit.outcome: Attempted all three official character-specific records; the web tool reported them inaccessible. Local exact rows were checked as described, but are not emitted as external evidence.

gaps: The official Unicode Unihan individual records for 網 U+7DB2, 网 U+7F51, and 罔 U+7F54 were inaccessible. Local source rows confirm current kMandarin wǎng for all three and Baxter–Sagart table rows give matching MC/OC notation, but these are not a substitute for inspected official character-specific click-through records.

網’s sound element is analyzed as 罔 and CUHK gives matching Guangyun category for 网/網. Local Baxter–Sagart rows also show matching *maŋʔ forms, but there is no independently inspected primary historical phonology source here; sound similarity does not independently prove the proposed graphic history.
The source-reported oracle-bone examples are not assigned absolute dates on the opened page. The bronzes are reported as name uses, with no dated examples supplied.

The sense record does not establish a dated path from net object to figurative legal or governance ‘web’, nor the first appearance of modern network senses. The variant dictionary gives examples, but example order is not chronology.

There is a classification difference in emphasis: CUHK calls net graph 网 the early form and says simplified usage revives it; the Taiwan MOE entry treats 网 as a variant of 網 and cites received lexicographic usage. This evidence supports an older related graph adopted as the standardized simplified form, but neither inspected entry gives a detailed official simplification history.

No securely reused bulk extract is recommended: exact page citations suffice and no broad reuse terms were verified for the recurring dictionaries. The selected single Commons image has file-level CC0 information and an attribution to Sinica-derived glyph material.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 网 in a Shuowen seal-script style. The early net graph is described in paleographic accounts as an open frame crossed by mesh lines; this redraw illustrates a later stylized form, not an excavated object.
items.alt: Black seal-script character form for 网, centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: Exact Commons description page identifies the graph and script style, gives an original SVG link, and documents CC0 rights. Useful as an explicitly modern illustration of the seal-stage form.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the file page; the page attributes its Sinica-sourced picture to the Sinica database CC0 notice.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw identified by the file description as Shuowen seal-script style, not an ancient artifact photograph. No pixel-level inspection was performed in this research stage.
